description: E2d4: human decisions on the reference audit proposals in docs/reference_audit_proposals.json. One decision per proposal: accepted (apply the proposed text), rejected (keep the reference), or edited (apply the reviewer's own text for the same span). Each names the reviewer by a pseudonymous handle (no real names unless the reviewer consents) and the date. Only these decisions change a reference; an agent never writes here. Empty until a human reviews.
